Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Macon for 2026, and here is what he found: 17 family events, 9 of them free. The magic runs from the Macon Pops Christmas Spectacular and the Christmas Light Extravaganza (November 27) through Festival of Trees at the Museum of Arts and Sciences (January 9), with the Downtown Macon Christmas Parade (December 6), Marche de Noel (December 4 to 13), the Nutcracker of Middle Georgia (December 9 to 13) and Elf Jr. at Macon Little Theatre (December 18 to 20) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website or an official calendar, and each listing links straight there.

  • Parades and lights: Downtown Macon Christmas Parade (December 6), Gray Christmas Parade (December 8), Christmas at the Cross (December 4) and the Christmas Light Extravaganza (November 27 to January 3)
